classification.question_topic: Asking whether a dream interaction (contract/barcode scan) meant being identified/tagged/listed

meta.final_emotion: worried; woke up after they said "next"
meta.author_theory: Did I just get an ID? Or tagged? Or put on some kind of list?

qualities.raw_description: Interaction with two people in black suits; a man was watching from the dreamer's right.

interactions.description: A woman in a black suit with white hair in a pixie cut told the dreamer to take out their phone and choose a color between red and blue. The dreamer chose a pretty dark purple; she said lighter in color. She told the dreamer to make a contract with that color in the phone and set the contract image. The image was like an AI image of a purple forest on a metallic mountain with a barcode. She scanned it for a long time; there was no beep.

entities_involved.description: Woman in a black suit; white hair in a pixie cut; gives instructions involving phone, color choice, and a 'contract'; scans a barcode for a long time with no beep; later talks in a cryptic riddle-like way.

interactions.description: The dreamer noticed a man watching from their right: older and bald, wearing a similar black suit.

entities_involved.description: Older bald man in a black suit, watching from the dreamer's right.

interactions.description: The woman started talking in a cryptic way like a riddle. The man repeated some of it and added some to it. The man stood and whispered into the woman's ear. They left together and came back. In unison they said "next" and the dreamer woke up.

entities_involved.description: Woman in black suit with white pixie-cut hair; speaks cryptically; leaves and returns; says "next" in unison with the man.
Older bald man in black suit; repeats/adds to the riddle; whispers into the woman's ear; leaves and returns; says "next" in unison with her.

extraction.extraction_notes: No explicit setting (mall/school/etc.) described; extracted as a single unspecified location. Phone 'contract image' described as AI-like (purple forest on metallic mountain) but no actual post image attached.
